Element.attribute: APR 2016 - Renamed work product to make it more descriptive. Enhanced content in Brief Description, and Purpose. Added Brief Outline.
To facilitate the integration of data from one or more source systems into target system(s) in order to meet data consumption requirements of all end users.

The Data Mapping Specification documents typically contain the following information:

  • Entity mappings for source and target systems
  • Attribute and field mappings for source and target systems
  • Join logic for entities, attributes, and fields
  • Entity and attribute filter tables
  • Reference data entities and attributes
  • Value mapping tables
  • Data mapping issues log
